d0.title: GameView recording request
d0.description: A versioned request to record the current GameView as an MP4 artifact.

schemaVersion.description: The GameView recording request schema version. The only supported value is 1.

frameRate.description: The requested constant video frame rate, within the current recording capability.

maxDurationSeconds.description: An optional per-recording duration limit in seconds, within the current recording capability.

d1.description: The positive width and height of a pixel surface.

width.description: The positive surface width in pixels.

height.description: The positive surface height in pixels.
